Crafting Blackstar Weapons  !Image!Image  From this point on, your objective will be to complete Calpheon and Mediah main story questlines to obtain the knowledge “The Three Legendary Blacksmiths of Mediah” in order to craft your Blackstar weapons. This can be obtained by completing a short questline. Press “O” to open your quest log, then the “Suggested” tab. You will then find the questline “[Lv. 51] Mediah: The Legendary Blacksmith”, which starts with Tulem, the arms dealer in Altinova.    REQUIREMENTS:  - 3 Boss Gear pieces at +0 to sacrifice for the quest - For any of the Blackstar weapons quests, you will need to use Kzarka, Kutum, Nouver, Offin Tett, or Dandelion, - For any of the Blackstar armor quests, you can use any boss weapon or armor piece,  - Remnants of the Rift x1 - Obtained as a rare drop when defeating Dark Rift bosses., - Can also be obtained as a rare drop from Golden Treasure Chests which require a Gold Key to open.,  - Specter’s Energy x1 (not required for mainhand weapon) - Obtained as a rare drop when killing monsters at Bashim Base, Titium Valley, Desert Naga Temple, Waragon Nest, Gahaz Bandit’s Lair, Cadry Ruins, Crescent Shrine, Taphtar Plain, Basilisk Den, Pila Ku Jail, Roud Sulfur Mine, Polly’s Forest, Loopy Tree Forest, Manshaum Forest, Tooth Fairy Forest, Tshira Ruins, Blood Wolf Settlement, Sherekhan Necropolis, Protty Cave, Sycraia Underwater Ruins (Upper Zone),  > 1.1 FREE PEN BLACKSTAR WEAPON All players can obtain 1 free PEN (V) Blackstar weapon of their choice. These rewards are each available once per family and have the following requirements:  Reach level 61+ with your character Complete one of the following: Simplified Main Questline Main Questline up to Mediah Mountain of Eternal Winter Main Questline Land of the Morning Light Main Questline  The weapon box can then be obtained from your (Y) Challenge Rewards.  > 1.2 BLACKSTAR ARMOR (NOT RECOMMENDED) Blackstar Armors are not recommended due to them being much more difficult to enhance. It is much easier and more obtainable to get a PEN boss armor and put caphras levels into it for immediate gains. Blackstar Armor can be upgraded (like caphras levels) using the Serendia Elvia materials, but these cannot be bought from the market and require hundreds of grinding yourself. In addition, you need a PEN Blackstar Armor to upgrade to Fallen God/Labreska (best in slot armors), which is far more difficult than needing a PEN Boss armor with level 10 caphras.  > 1.3 GODR-AYED WEAPON (NOT RECOMMENDED) Godr-Ayed weapons were released as an alternative to Blackstar weapons. However, our guide will not cover information about them, since after the implementation of Sovereign weapons they have become useless. Additionally, Godr-Ayed weapons are extremely difficult to enhance, making them basically a "noob trap."  Once you have everything you need, you can start the questline by right-clicking the Remnants of the Rift item. Take the Remnants of the Rift item to Martha Kiyen located at Northern Wheat Plantation to begin.    Continue to Progression  ➡ Sovereign Weapons

Melissia Games FAQ  This website has the answers to most of your questions. Use search bar to find what you need.  !image  General FAQ  !  WHAT IS MELISSIA GAMES CURRENT VERSION? Melissia Games current update is based on the January 15, 2025.  WHERE CAN I DOWNLOAD THE GAME? You can download the game from the Setup Guide section.  HOW IS MELISSIA SERVER RATES?  You can check our rates here: Server Info  DOES MELISSIA PROVIDE CUSTOM CONTENT? Melissia doesn't introduce extreme changes or custom items and exchange NPCs. Instead, it focuses on enhancing gameplay mechanics, balancing rates, and providing generous rewards. This way, we maintain the original experience, but with the benefit of obtaining your resources much faster, without requiring you to dedicate a massive amount of hours.  DO I NEED TO DO THE MAIN QUEST, ADVENTURE LOG AND MAGNUS? The game itself provides a system where you can choose between the conventional path of completing the entire Main Quest or skipping the process through the Simplified Questline. You can find more details in the Naked to Graduated and Progression Guide. As for the Adventure Logs, they must be completed in full.  - Our current patch includes Igor Bartali’s Adventure Log rework, making it faster and easier to complete all the books. > Keep in mind that quests generally proceed and are completed in the same way as retail, but some differences may exist.  HOW TO DO MAGNUS? For details check our Magnus Guide.  Magnus is simplified and there is no need to bother with details and puzzles. Almost all tasks can be completed just by talking to the cat. If you have problems you can solve them with relog.  Fairy can be obtained by completing a short questline, similar to retail. You can check the full guide here: Fairy Guide  SHOULD I START WITH A NORMAL OR SEASONAL CHARACTER?  Although we provide temporary gear (15 days) for normal characters, we recommend starting your journey with a Seasonal Character. Seasonal characters receive all the necessary materials and gear to ensure a smooth and comfortable start on the server.  You can find more details in the Naked to Graduated and Progression Guide  HOW CAN I OBTAIN PEARLS? You can obtain a total of 4,800 Pearls daily: 2.400 Pearls by completing various activities (killing mobs, Life Skills such as gathering and fishing). The amount of Pearls you actively collect will increase according to your monster, gathering and fishing level.  2.400 Pearls by staying logged in on your character. 80 Pearls every 30 minutes (100 Pearls every 30 minutes if you have Premium).  WHY ARE THE ENHANCEMENT RATES DIFFERENT FROM RETAIL? You can check the enhancement rates here: Enhancement  HOW TO GET THOSE COOL TITLES? After purchasing (You must use it) a premium through theweb shop, you will also permanently receive the following titles below: 7 days - Arsha's Proof 15 days - Arsha's Acknowledgment 30 days - Arsha's Blessing & Stormtrooper 60days - Arsha's Honor & Special Force Commander 90 days - Arsha's Glory & Ultimate Weapon  WHAT ARE THE PREMIUM BENEFITS?  After activating your Melissia Games UI, you can access its features through the Menu in the upper right corner of the screen.  !  Here you will have access to the following features: - Boss Timer – You can teleport directly to the boss. - Teleport – You can save up to 3 custom teleport locations. - Drop Filter – You can filter out various unwanted item drops.  HOW IS LIFE SKILL WORKS? Many Life Skill activities in Melissia Games are buffed. The EXP you gain and the loot you obtain are significantly increased.  DO AGRIS, LOOT SCROLL, AND HEDGEHOG (PET) HAVE A DIRECT EFFECT ON THE AMOUNT OF RESOURCES OBTAINED THROUGH GATHERING? Yes.

The Magnus Melissia has a simplified version of the Magnus questline, where you don’t need to worry about details and puzzles. Almost all quests can be completed simply by talking to the black cat in front of your spawn location.  SPECIFIC ISSUES There is a possibility that you will be disconnected a few times during the loading screens. If you have any problem with a quest objective, first try: Exit Magnus through the "Esc" menu. Forfeit the quest and then accept it again (outside of Magnus). Return to the Magnus core and then enter the instance again. Relog.  REWARDS If you complete all the challenges by finishing the Magnus main questline, you can unlock 4 special rewards including a free PEN boss armor and Abyssal skills for all your characters.  FREE PEN BOSS GEAR You’ll be able to choose one free PEN boss defense gear (once per Family). This gear cannot be registered on the Central Market. For the helmet and armor pieces, if you enhance it past Caphras Lv. 10, you’ll be able to craft the Ancient gear set (Fallen God’s Armor, Labreska’s Helmet), which then can be registered on the Central Market.  FAST TRAVEL As you progress through the questline, you will unlock "Fast Travel" to major cities through the Magnus. Once you are at the Magnus Well location, interact with the Abyssal Well to open a map and select your destination. You can then jump into the well to teleport to that location. You can utilize the Magnus realm, to travel between major cities. You can find abyssal wells that are connected to the Magnus on the World Map (M). Fast travel between the different locations cost 5 million silver.  STORAGE REMOTE ACCESS As you progress through the questline, you will also unlock remote access to other regions’ Storage. Due to all regions now being connected through the Magnus, all inventory items can be accessed from any region. You can move and store all inventory items from storages across all regions through a Storage Maid NPC. You can use Storage Maids to transfer items to different storages even if you are not in that area. The feature is only available in regions that are lit up on the map. (Not available in Muiquun and Port Ratt.) You cannot transport trade items, exchange items, treasure items, Ornette’s Spirit Essence, Odore’s Spirit Essence, and basic potion items via this function.  ABYSSAL LEGACY SKILL (ALL CLASSES) Once you completed the main questline, you can receive a new skill for your class called the “Abyssal skill”. If you have completed the main questline on another character, you do not need to do the questline again for another class. Simply talk to your Black Spirit to obtain the following quests: “[The Magnus] Abyssal Revelation”. To accept and complete the “[The Magnus] Abyssal revelation” quest, your character needs to be level 60 or higher. Upon completing “[The Magnus] Abyssal Revelation,” you’ll obtain [Secret Book] Abyssal Legacy x1 and [Event] Armstrong’s Skill Guide (1 Day) x1. If you lose the secret book item, as long as your character has completed the “[The Magnus] Revelations” quest, you can get another one by talking to Cruhorn Wyrmsbane. Once you use the secret book and learn the new skill, it will replace the skill commands of one Absolute skill in your character’s kit. You can still add and use the replaced Absolute skill via Quick Slot.  OTHER REWARDS You can check all progression rewards here: The Magnus - Once per Family quest rewards  GENERAL TIPS FOR SPECIFIC QUESTS  !Image  QUEST: LOOK BEFORE YOU... - Keep going up until the stairs end, then interact with the secret part in the wall. - After that, kill the NPC next to you and continue up the stairs. - Repeat the process. - When you finish all 4 hints and are at the top, talk to the cat to teleport out.  QUEST: FINDING MEMORIES / ESCAPE - It’s a simple quest, but you might end up getting confused if you take the wrong path. - Go to the room with the sphere-shaped relics and a cutscene will trigger, then the quest “Escape” will begin. - Go around the rooms until you reach the exit with a cat at the bottom. - Talk to the cat to finish.  QUEST: MEMORIES OF THE DEEP SEA - Many people get lost here because of all these cats. - Just talk to each cat until you find the correct one and your quest will be completed.  QUEST: THE ONLY THING THA MATTERS - There will be two cats near the NPC Gorgath. Talk to the one that is slightly farther away and the quest will be completed. - Talk to the cat again and you will be sent back to the Magnus core. - Once you are back at the Magnus core, talk to the NPC Gorgath.  QUEST: FINAL STEP - Follow the path up the tree, talk to the cat, and teleport back to Magnus. - A cutscene should trigger, which will complete the quest. - If that doesn’t happen, use a tool like RivaTuner to lower your FPS and then click the “Return to Magnus” button. - If it still doesn’t trigger automatically, try interacting with the part on the floor, as shown in this video.

Our server's custom enhancement rates Click for Enhancement Information mean you do not need to hoard silver, crons, or failstacks, nor will you cry over RNG failure chances.  1. Clear the final remaining Season Pass checkboxes (e.g., talking to Fughar or using a specific seasonal item).  NOW YOU HAVE FULL PEN TUVALA  ! > Yeah, it's the same picture from the top.   ---  THE LAST LAP: MONSTER SLAUGHTER & AWAKENING   We have reached the absolute final stretch of the run.  There should only be 3-4 quests left in the Season Pass: a few "Kill X number of monsters" tasks, and the "Complete your Awakening/Succession questline" task.   I recommend heading to the [Blood Wolf Settlement] to execute the monster-killing quests. content: PEN BOSS GEAR, DARK RIFT and DEBO REKA PREPARATION  !Image  !Image   1.1 BOSS GEAR SET The Boss gear set consists of following items:   - Giath's & Griffon's Helmet., - Dim Tree Spirit's & Red Nose's Armor., - Bheg's Gloves., - Muskan's & Urugon's Shoes.,   You can obtain boss gear through World Boss drops, Central Market or Jetina guaranteed PEN Boss Gear. While grinding, make sure to complete your daily Dark Rift bosses in order to build toward Deboreka accessories.    1.2 DEC TUVALA GEAR (OPTIONAL) As an optional step, you can also obtain DEC Tuvala gear through a quest provided by Jetina. You can choose 1 PEN Tuvala weapon and 1 PEN Tuvala accessory, obtained from the Season Servers, to enhance up to DEC (X) enhancement level.   - Once you reach DEC enhancement, you can swap the weapon for a PEN Blackstar Weapon, the armor for a TRI Slumbering Armor, and the accessory for a TET Kharazad Accessory., - The gear cannot be sold on the central market, but the PEN Blackstar can be used to turn into a Sovereign Weapon., - You will obtain a weapon box of your choice (mainhand/awakening/offhand) and can open the box on any character to obtain a weapon for that class., - You can choose which Slumbering Armor you would like to obtain when exchanging your Tuvala Armor (Silent Labreska’s Helmet, Silent Fallen God’s Armor, Silent Dahn’s Gloves, Silent Ator’s Shoes)., - You can choose which accessory you would like to obtain when exchanging your Tuvala Accessory. Eg. DEC Tuvala Necklace can be exchanged for a TET Kharazad Belt.,   NOTE: DEC Tuvala armor enhancement is not available in the current patch. DEC Tuvala gear can only be obtained once per account, and the exchange can only be completed once per account. To get started, you will need a character that has graduated from Season and has a Seasonal Graduation Cap in their inventory.    1.3 JETINA PEN ACCESSORY (OPTIONAL) Another alternative progression path is obtaining a free PEN Accessory through Jetina quest. All players can obtain up to 2 PEN accessories using this method and it is much much cheaper than trying to create or buy a PEN accessory.   - You can only create up to TWO Jetina PEN accessories per account., - You can only choose between a PEN Narc Ear Earring, Tungrad Earring, or Ring of Crescent Guardian., - The Jetina PEN accessories cannot be sold on the market., - You will need to have a character that is level 56+., - This method takes preparation, requires a lot of materials, and at least 8 billion raw silver to buy certain materials.,   Go to NPC Jetina in Velia and she will give you a quest called “Old Moon Guild’s Trade Offer”.   - The quest can be found in your quest log (O) under the “Suggested” tab > “[Combat][Lv. 56] PEN (V) Gear – The Old Moon’s Best Deal”.,     1.4 DEBOREKA ACCESSORIES Your long-term accessory goal is the Deboreka set (Necklace, Belt, Earring & Ring), which will later be converted into Kharazad accessories. However, since you are still at the beginning of your progression, you should focus on obtaining them through Dark Rifts and save it to enhance later.    1.5 YELLOW GRADE ACCESSORIES While grinding, make sure to save all yellow grade accessories to converted into Essence of Dawn. Essence of Dawn will be crucial for upgrading your Kharazad accessories later in the game.   !Image  After finishing your PEN Boss armor, you will focus on converting your gear to the best-in-slot version, known as the “Ancient gear set.” In addition, you will also begin investing in your Deboreka accessories.  Continue to Progression with Upgrading Boss Armor and Deboreka Accessories

Melissia Games Season System Guide   !    🔸 HOW DOES THE SEASON SYSTEM WORK ON MELISSIA?  You can check Naked to Graduated to get the detailed season guide and finish the season in 2 hours. Melissia gives you the freedom to create multiple Season characters on your account by using the Season Expansion Coupon. Due to this, you can also claim season rewards multiple times. However, keep in mind that you can only have one active Season character at a time. If you wish to create a new one, you must first graduate your currently active Season character.    🔸 HOW MUCH TIME DOES IT TAKE TO FINISH THE SEASON?  If you follow Naked to Graduated you can finish the season in 2 hours.  🔸 IS THERE A TIME LIMIT TO STAY IN SEASON?  Yes, there is. Seasonal Channel is accessible for the first 30 days after a player first enters it, as well as for returning players who have been inactive for more than 90 days   🔸 CAN I FORCE GRADUATE TO LEAVE THE SEASON EARLY?  Yes, you can do this at any time. However, if you are a new player, we do not recommend doing so, as there is no real benefit in giving up your Season rewards just to graduate early. Remaining in the Season allows you to fully take advantage of the progression bonuses, materials, and exclusive rewards available during the Season period. Additionally, keep in mind that drop rates, EXP gains, and other bonuses are higher on the Season server.    🔸 WHICH STARTING ZONE SHOULD I CHOOSE?  Naked to Graduated If you are a new player and wants a faster and smoother experience, the only viable option is Ancient Stone Chamber. By starting there, you will have access to several beginner grind spots and can focus purely on gaining EXP by killing monsters, if you prefer. On the other hand, if you choose Land of the Morning Light or Mountain of Eternal Winter, keep in mind that your progression will be slower and heavily gated behind a long questline.    🔸 DO I HAVE TO DO ALL THE MAIN QUEST LINE?  The game currently offers the "Simplified Main Quest" system, which allows both Season and regular characters to skip the entire main questline up to Mediah. Due to this, you can progress purely by killing monsters and leveling up, without being forced to complete the main story quests. Naked to Graduated  Click to Go to ➡ Progression Guide

SOVEREIGN WEAPONS  !  Your final goal here will be to craft your Sovereign Weapons. Sovereign weapons are a Primordial tier weapon and the best weapons available in the game. Our current update only has the main hand and awakening weapons available. There are 3 different methods that can be used to create a Sovereign Weapon. Each method requires different items and depends on your situation and current gear.   - You can use any PEN Blackstar Weapons and aSovereign Weapon will be created for the class you are currently playing. - Eg. If you are logged into your Warrior class and use a Blackstar Longbow and Blackstar Amulet (method 2), you will receive a Sovereign Longsword weapon.,  - If you want to create a mainhand sovereign weapon, you will need to use mainhand Blackstar weapons. If you want to make an awakening sovereign weapon, you must use awakening Blackstar weapons., - Other than the crafting materials, there are no other requirements. You do not need to complete the main story quests or reach a certain character level., - If you have upgraded your weapon with a Garmoth’s Heart, Karanda Heart or Kutum Heart, you will need to remove the item first using a Mirror of Equilibrium (purchased from a Blacksmith)., - Sovereign Weapons cannot be registered or purchased from the central market.,   Once you have the items needed for one of the crafting methods, you can craft the weapon by interacting with the "Bonghwang Statue" on top of the Land of the Morning Light’s Mount Ahshi.    1.1 MAINHAND & AWAKENING WEAPONS  METHOD 1: Combine PEN (V) Blackstar mainhand/awakening weapon with Flame of the Primordial.   - Flame of the Primordial can be obtained by processing (L), Heating: - Embers of the Primordial X100.,    To collect the Embers of the Primordial, you need to complete a weekly quest that requires you to defeat a Land of the Morning Light: Seoul World Boss. The weekly quest appears automatically when you enter the boss spawn location and rewards you with a loot box that has a chance of containing Primordial Crystals, Embers of the Primordial, Sovereign Weapon Reforge Stones, and other valuable loot. There are 4 bosses in total, meaning you can obtain up to 4 loot boxes each week.  METHOD 2: Combine TWO PEN (V) Blackstar mainhand/awakening weapons.   - You must use the same type of weapon (Eg: if you want to create a mainhand Sovereign weapon, you must use PEN Blackstar Mainhand x2 and cannot use a Blackstar Awakening weapon)., - However, you can use any mainhand Blackstar weapon (Eg: You can use a Blackstar Longbow and a Blackstar Amulet. The Sovereign weapon will be created for the class you are currently playing).,    METHOD 3: Combine PEN (V) Blackstar mainhand/awakening Weapon + Caphras Lv. 20 Boss Weapon + Gem of Twilight.   - This method is the most expensive option., - For the boss weapons you can use a PEN Kzarka Mainhand Weapon (Caphras Lv.20), PEN Offin Tett’s Radiant Mainhand Weapon (Caphras Lv. 20), or PEN Dandelion Awakening Weapon (Caphras Lv. 20).,   Gem of Twilight is obtained by processing (L), heating:   - Magical Shards x100, - Caphras Stones x20,000,   1.2 SOVEREIGN WEAPON REFORGE EFFECTS In addition to their superior stats, the Sovereign weapons can be reforged to have an additional 5 effects.   - These 5 effects are chosen by the player and are added to the weapon or swapped by using a special reforge stone., - The reforge stones drop randomly when defeating world bosses in the Land of the Morning Light: Seoul region., - Some of the “core” (common) effects such as Extra Damage, HP, Damage Reduction, etc. have a higher drop chance, while more unique effects have a lower chance of being obtained, making them harder to acquire., - Each of the Reforge stones can be registered and purchased through the central market.,   You can find more detailed information about the reforging system here: Sovereign weapon reforge system   1.3 CAPHRAS STONES GRIND Due to the higher server rates, it is possible to farm a good amount of Caphras per hour through Gathering. Because of the Life Skill QoL improvements present in the current patch, it is no longer necessary to have tools in order to perform gathering activities (plants, minerals, and animals). The most efficient ways to obtain Caphras currently are:   - Gathering Potatoes (Finto Farm, Bartali Farm, and Loggia Farm). - Gathering Cotton (Ahto Farm and Kasula Farm). - Killing mobs in Elvia Spots  !Image!Image
Click to Make Suggestion

UPGRADING BOSS ARMOR AND DEBOREKA ACCESSORIES   1.1 ANCIENT GEAR SET The Ancient gear set consists of 4 pieces:   - Labreska Helmet (Mountain of Eternal Winter region), - Fallen God Armor (O’Dylita region), - Dahn’s Gloves (Land of the Morning Light region), - Ator’s Shoes (Ulukita region),   Each of these pieces is made through a specific quest that requires a “flame” and a PEN boss armor (with Caphras level 10) corresponding to that item. For example: Griffon’s or Giath’s for Labreska, Dim Tree Spirit’s or Red Nose’s for Fallen God, etc. NOTE: To access the quest guide for each item, simply click on the hyperlinks above.   1.2 UPGRADE DEBOREKA ACCESSORIES You will also begin your journey to enhance the Deboreka accessories that you have been saving up to TET. Once you have upgraded your accessory to TET, you can exchange it for a PEN Kharazad Accessory with the same stats. To do this, you must first complete a pre-quest and then exchange your accessory at the NPC Clorince in Velia (General Goods Merchant).   - You can only exchange a TET (IV) or PEN (V) Deboreka accessory for a PEN (V) or NOV (IX) Kharazad Accessory, respectively, - The Deboreka Accessory must not be upgraded with a cup accessory upgrade (extract the cup first), - Make sure all quests types are turned on in your Quest Log (O), - Once the pre-quest is completed once by your Family, the other exchange quests can be completed without any limits., - Do not forfeit the quest after handing over an accessory, because you will not be able to reobtain the item.,     1.3 YELLOW GRADE ACCESSORIES & ESSENCE OF DAWN You can obtain Essence of Dawn and Essence of Dawn – BSR/ACC/DR/EVA by Processing (L) > Heating, yellow grade TET or PEN accessories with Dawn’s Aura x1. Dawn’s Aura can be purchased from Old Moon Manager NPCs for 5 million Silver.   - Black Distortion Earring: TET (IV) x72 / PEN (V) x720, - Vaha’s Dawn: TET (IV) x72 / PEN (V) x720, - Ogre Ring: TET (IV) x30 / PEN (V) x300, - Laytenn’s Power Stone: TET (IV) x30 / PEN (V) x300, - Eye of the Ruins Ring: TET (IV) x22 / PEN (V) x225, - Ring of Crescent Guardian: TET (IV) x20 / PEN (V) x200, - Valtarra Eclipsed Belt: TET (IV) x17 / PEN (V) x175, - Basilisk’s Belt: TET (IV) x15 / PEN (V) x150, - Serap’s Necklace: TET (IV) x7 / PEN (V) x75, - Jetina Accessories (Narc Ear Accessory, Tungrad Earring, Ring of Crescent Guardian): PEN (V) x100,   NOTE: PEN Jetina Accessories only provide 100 Dawn of Essence when heated, as they are cheaper to obtain compared to normal PEN accessories of the same type.   1.4 EXCHANGING ESSENCE OF DAWN Essence of Dawn – Black Spirit’s Rage/Accuracy/Damage Reduction/Evasion can be exchanged into normal Essence of Dawn according to a 1:1 ratio via NPC Dalishain in town.   - You can also obtain Essence of Dawn and Essence of Dawn – BSR/ACC/DR/EVA by Processing (L) > Heating, Dawn Crystals (Kharazad exclusive crystals)., - Dawn Crystals can be obtained from the Land of the Morning Light monster zones.,  Continue to Progression  ➡ Crafting Blackstar Weapons
